notes: Dice order per swing = BattleResolver.resolve: attack 2d6, defense 2d6, damage die only if landed, Fate roll 0..99 only if landed and Fate > 0 (crit when roll < Fate, x2 after rounding).
Rootbind turns and the first-hit floor consume no dice. A hybrid picks the mode with the better (offense - defender (guard+swift)//2) margin; ties go physical.
Rootbind halving is applied to the Keeper's final damage (after crit): max(1, round_half_up(damage / 2)); consumed by his next Strike even on a miss.
First-hit floor: the echo's first landed hit leaves the Keeper at least max_hp // 10 + 1.
outcome spare_window = echo at or below 10% (hp*10 <= max_hp); ko = Keeper at or below 10%; timeout = 60 rounds, a loss.
Rounds: Swiftness order fixed for the fight, Keeper wins ties.

replays.note: turns holds only the last two turns; every turn is a miss
